simple.summary: הָהּ (hâhh) means ah! expressing grief First listed occurrence: Ezek 30 2.

definitions.full: H1929. hah הָהּ interjection expressing woe, alas! Ezek 30:2 howl ye לַיּוֺם הָהּ alas for the day! AV woe worth the day! (compare לַיּוֺם אֲהָהּ Joel 1:15 .)
